Supreme Court to hear pleas on police action during paper leak protests

The Supreme Court is scheduled to hear a batch of petitions on Monday concerning police actions during protests against exam paper leaks. Separately, a judge handling paper leak cases at a Delhi fast-track court has been transferred a week after the first hearing. The human impact of exam paper leaks, particularly on young lives, has also been highlighted. Meanwhile, the Punjab Assembly saw disruptions over paper leak allegations, with the Congress demanding a minister's resignation. The Delhi High Court has also sought a response from the NIA regarding Aasiya Andrabi's appeal against a UAPA conviction.
